enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a cool temperature through the hot night.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and brushing teeth.
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and get out of bed. Walk to bathroom and turn on light. Use toilet and flush. Wash hands. Turn on shower and adjust water temperature. Step into shower and wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower and dry with towel. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Turn off light and walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, drinking plenty of water before the hot day.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Remove toast from toaster. Put toast on plate. Eat breakfast. Drink a glass of water.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in light work clothes, packing a work bag, refilling a water bottle and applying sunscreen.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and trousers. Put on shirt and trousers. Put on socks. Pick up work bag. Open work bag. Place items into work bag. Close work bag. Pick up water bottle. Refill water bottle. Apply sunscreen to face and arms.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital in the already warming morning heat by public transport (bus/train, walking as needed; not using the household electric vehicle).
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up work bag and water bottle. Leave bedroom. Walk to front door. Open front door. Close front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone for bus arrival time. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Arriving at the hospital, changing into work uniform and reviewing the day's patient list.
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Walk to changing room. Open locker. Take out work uniform. Change into work uniform. Place civilian clothes in locker. Close locker. Walk to office. Pick up patient list. Review patient list.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing patients, running treatment and rehabilitation sessions, and supervising exercise programmes.
enriched_activities.desc: Greet patient. Review patient's medical history. Assess patient's physical condition. Measure joint range of motion. Palpate muscles. Set up treatment equipment. Apply heat or cold therapy. Instruct patient on exercise. Demonstrate exercise movement. Supervise patient performing exercise. Correct patient's form. Document treatment notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat assessment and treatment. Communicate with other staff. Prepare handover notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating and rehydrating in the air-conditioned staff room.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Eat lunch. Drink water. Close lunch box. Throw away trash. Walk out of staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: afternoon patient sessions, mobility training, clinical notes and handover preparation.
enriched_activities.desc: Greet afternoon patient. Review patient's progress. Conduct mobility training. Assist patient with walking. Use gait belt. Monitor patient's vital signs. Adjust exercise plan. Document clinical notes. Update patient records. Communicate with nursing staff. Prepare handover notes. Attend handover meeting. Discuss patient status. Update handover board. Clean treatment area. Organize equipment.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital during the peak of the heatwave by public transport (not using the household electric vehicle).
enriched_activities.desc: Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone for bus schedule. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open front door. Enter home. Close front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light casual clothes.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature to cool. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on light casual clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood, with cool drinks from the refrigerator.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Take out cool drink. Close refrigerator. Open drink bottle. Drink. Place cutting board on counter. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on induction cooker. Add oil to pan. Add ingredients to pan. Stir ingredients. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Plate food.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and tidying the dishes into the dishwasher.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Scrape plates. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on, watching TV.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on sofa. Pick up TV remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Change channel again. Adjust sitting position. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on to review clinical notes and do continuing professional education.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter study. Turn on light. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open clinical notes file. Read clinical notes. Type notes. Open web browser. Access continuing education website. Watch educational video. Take notes. Close web browser. Close clinical notes. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing stretching and mobility exercises on the floor before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Lay out exercise mat on floor. Sit on mat. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch legs. Perform torso twists. Perform neck rolls. Perform hip stretches. Perform hamstring stretches. Stand up. Roll up mat. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Browsing the phone and reading while lying down, with the air conditioner running.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like a post. Comment on a post. Close social media app. Open e-book app. Read e-book. Turn page. Adjust screen brightness. Put down phone. Pick up physical book. Read book. Turn page. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap and wet face. Apply cleanser and rub face. Rinse face and dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Use toilet and flush. Wash hands. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the light off and the air conditioner keeping the room cool.
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
